question: What three starting symptoms are listed in the introductory description of the Startability Tests?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Engine does not start.
Engine starts but immediately stops.
Engine is very hard to start.

question: According to the Engine Running Tests introduction, which symptoms call for these tests, and which starting symptoms are directed to the Startability Tests?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Starts but runs poorly or does not remain running: Engine Running Tests.
Does not start, immediately stops, or is very hard to start: Startability Tests.

question: What two major cooling functions are covered by the top-level Cooling System Tests?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Water-cooling system.
Oil-cooling system.

question: What is the purpose of the HMMWV venting system during normal operation and deep-water fording?
finding: 환기 목적의 필수 사실은 온전하다. 부품 위치 안내의 별도 문장 연결 오류는 C001409·C001410에 기록했다.

required_elements.text: Normal operation: allow vapor to escape to the atmosphere.
Deep-water fording: prevent venting so water does not enter the engine and other systems.

question: For which three general engine symptoms does the manual recommend the Fuel System Tests?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Hard starting.
Low power.
Rough running.

question: What vehicle symptoms may justify checking the air intake/exhaust system?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Hard to start.
Runs rough.
Does not develop full power.

question: What is the primary purpose of the Compression/Mechanical Tests?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Determine whether the engine has internal compression or mechanical problems.
Fix what is possible without having to notify DS maintenance.

question: Are the Engine Cooling Tests intended to diagnose a faulty temperature sending unit or gauge?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: No: the paragraph excludes temperature sending-unit and gauge diagnosis.

question: According to the Engine Cooling Tests operating description, at what coolant temperature does the thermostat start to open?
finding: 열림 시작 온도와 완전 열림 온도를 구분했다.

required_elements.text: Starts to open at 190°F, approximately 88°C (87.7°C in §2-25).

question: At approximately what coolant temperature should the engine fan be activated?
finding: 냉각팬 작동 기준과 thermostat 온도를 구분했다.

required_elements.text: Fan activation at 215°F (102°C).

question: What coolant mixture is normally specified for the engine cooling system?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Normally a 50:50 mixture of water and ethylene-glycol-base antifreeze.

question: At approximately what cooling-system pressure does the surge-tank cap valve open?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Approximately 15 psi (103 kPa).

question: In the Engine Lubrication Tests reference for STE/ICE-R Test 10, what approximate cranking speed is stated?
finding: 윤활 진단의 약 200 rpm 조건을 다른 기동 시험 조건과 구분했다.

required_elements.text: Approximately 200 RPM in the stated Test 10 reference.

question: What idle-speed range is specified for the 6.2-liter engine in the Engine Lubrication Tests?
finding: 6.2 L 적용 조건을 유지했다.

required_elements.text: 650 ± 25 RPM, equivalent to 625-675 RPM, for the 6.2L engine.

question: Which diagnostic system does the manual direct the maintainer to check when the exhaust smoke is white?
finding: 같은 백색 연기 증상을 다루는 FUEL SYSTEM 진단 노드 C001838을 추가했다. 색상 안내 문장만 허용하는 민감도도 계산했다.

required_elements.text: Fuel system, §2-22.

question: What does blue exhaust smoke generally indicate according to the manual?
finding: 질문에 없는 오일 유입 경로를 필수 요소에서 제외했다. C002436 단독을 충분 근거로 인정했다.

required_elements.text: Blue smoke indicates oil entering the combustion chambers.

question: Which system should be checked when the exhaust smoke is black?
finding: 검은 연기와 막힌 필터의 관계를 명시한 INTAKE AIR/EXHAUST 노드 C001993을 추가했다.

required_elements.text: Air intake/exhaust system, §2-23.

question: What is the maximum acceptable battery internal resistance in STE/ICE-R Test 73?
finding: 25 max와 less than 25의 원문 표현 차이를 보존했다. 등호 경계를 시험하지 않는다.

required_elements.text: Maximum 25 milliohms in Test 73.

question: What is the maximum acceptable battery resistance-change value in STE/ICE-R Test 75?
finding: 저항 자체와 초당 저항 변화량을 구분했다.

required_elements.text: Maximum 50 milliohms/second in Test 75.

question: In Step 2 of the initial Starter Circuit diagnostic test, what minimum battery voltage is checked while attempting to crank the engine?
finding: 배터리의 크랭킹 중 전압 질문에 다른 부품 측정점을 전용하지 않았다.

required_elements.text: At least 18 V while attempting to crank.

question: During starter and battery checks, cranking voltage is 17 V and STE/ICE-R Test 73 reports 30 milliohms. Does each reading meet its stated limit? Give both limits.
finding: 전압 측정점이 질문에 명시되지 않았다. 기존 배터리 기준을 주 집계에 유지하고 다른 측정점 허용 및 문항 제외 민감도를 계산했다.

required_elements.text: Cranking-voltage minimum: 18 V.
17 V is below the limit.
Test 73 resistance threshold: 25 milliohms.
30 milliohms exceeds the limit.

question: A cold engine cranks at 90 RPM and STE/ICE-R Test 69 measures a starter negative-cable drop of 0.30 V. How does each reading compare with the manual guidance?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Cold cranking minimum: 100 RPM.
90 RPM is below the minimum.
Starter negative-cable drop must be less than 0.25 V.
0.30 V exceeds the limit.

question: Which cold-start circuit is excluded from the Glowplugs Circuit Tests, and what timing advance and engine-temperature condition does the Fuel System guidance state for checking that circuit?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Fuel-system cold-start advance circuit is not checked by the glowplug tests.
Advances injection-pump timing approximately 3-5 degrees.
Operation is checked with engine temperature below 90°F (32°C).

question: A rough-running engine emits white smoke. Which diagnostic system does the exhaust-color guidance direct the maintainer to, and what other two problem areas can cause rough running according to that system introduction?
finding: 질문이 배기색 지침을 특정하므로 직접적인 해당 지침을 유지했다.

required_elements.text: White smoke directs the maintainer to Fuel System Tests, §2-22.
Air intake/exhaust problems can also cause rough running.
Internal mechanical problems can also cause rough running.

question: For black exhaust smoke, which diagnostic system is indicated? During its air-intake PMCS checks, how is correct CDR-valve function determined, and what cleaning method is authorized?
finding: 검은 연기 진단의 동등 근거를 추가했다. 세척 금지 이유는 질문하지 않은 선택 정보다.

required_elements.text: Black smoke directs the maintainer to air intake/exhaust tests.
CDR function is determined by a water-manometer vacuum check.
Wipe the CDR valve with a rag.
Do not clean the CDR valve with solvent. The diaphragm-damage explanation is optional for this question.

question: What does blue exhaust smoke indicate, and what is the stated purpose of the Compression/Mechanical Tests? Answer from the smoke explanation and that test-section introduction.
finding: 오일 유입 경로는 선택 정보이므로 다음 청크를 필수로 요구하던 AND를 제거했다.

required_elements.text: Blue exhaust smoke indicates oil entering the combustion chambers. Specific entry routes are optional for this question.
Compression/Mechanical Tests determine internal compression or mechanical problems.
Fix what is possible without having to notify DS maintenance.

question: At approximately what pressure does the surge-tank cap valve relieve pressure, and what cap-removal precautions does the cooling-system PMCS warning specify after vehicle operation?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Cap relief pressure: approximately 15 psi (103 kPa).
Use care and heavy rags or gloves to avoid burns.
Turn the cap one-half turn counterclockwise.
Release pressure before fully removing the cap.

question: At what coolant temperature is the cooling fan activated, and which pump supplies hydraulic pressure to the fan-clutch system?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: Fan activation at 215°F (102°C).
Hydraulic pressure is supplied by the power-steering pump.

question: Which fluids are cooled in the upper and lower halves of the separate oil cooler, and what approximate engine-oil pressure does the lubrication-test chart show at 2,000 RPM?
finding: 질문이 지정한 표의 값과 다른 계기 설명의 범위를 혼합하지 않았다.

required_elements.text: Upper half: transmission oil.
Lower half: engine oil.
At 2,000 RPM, approximate engine-oil pressure is 40-50 psi.

question: A 6.2L engine idles at 650 RPM with 8 psi oil pressure, and its oil is known to be contaminated. Compare the pressure with the lubrication-test chart and state the PMCS action for contaminated oil.
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: The 6.2L idle oil-pressure chart gives approximately 10-15 psi.
8 psi is below the chart range.
Change both oil and oil filter when known to be contaminated.

question: For a vehicle other than M1123 or A2, what tension range is specified for a new accessory drivebelt, and what tightening torque is specified for alternator mounting bolts?
finding: 발전기 조임 토크는 60/100/200 A 항목이다. 질문의 용량 명시 부족을 표시하고 제외 민감도를 계산했다.

required_elements.text: New belt tension: 70-110 lb (311-489 N); the stated model exclusions apply.
Alternator mounting bolts: 40 lb-ft (54 N·m).

question: Loose starter mounting bolts are found during PMCS. Which forms and reporting timing apply to the shortcoming, and what tightening torque is specified for those bolts?
finding: 질문이 요구하는 사실·값·단위·대상·조건을 해당 원문 구간과 대조했다. 필수 요소의 추가 변경은 없다.

required_elements.text: DA Form 2404 or DA Form 5988-E.
Report immediately after PMCS and before corrective action.
Starter mounting bolts: 40 lb-ft (54 N·m).

question: PMCS finds service-brake pads 2.5 mm thick and tire tread 1.0 mm deep. Does each fall below its Not Fully Mission Capable threshold? State the respective limits.
finding: service brake, parking brake 및 dual service/park 구성을 구분하여 단순히 같은 두께라는 이유로 대체하지 않았다.

required_elements.text: Service-brake pad NMC threshold: below 1/8 inch (3.2 mm).
2.5 mm meets that deficiency criterion.
Tire-tread NMC threshold: below 1/16 inch (1.59 mm).
1.0 mm meets that deficiency criterion.

question: Compare the permitted fluid-level distances below the fill opening for the transfer case on level ground and for a differential with cold lubricant.
finding: transfer case와 differential의 액면 높이 및 온도 조건을 구분했다.

required_elements.text: Transfer case on level ground: within 1/2 inch (12.7 mm) of the fill-plug opening.
Cold differential lubricant: within 1/4 inch (6.4 mm) of the fill-plug opening.

question: In non-arctic service, may Dexron II be used in both a 4L80-E transmission and the transfer case? State each fluid requirement and the transfer-case level criterion on level ground.
finding: 오일 종류와 액면 기준은 서로 다른 요구다. 주입 용량을 액면 기준으로 인정하지 않았다. 원문의 DEXRON II/III 범위를 유지했다.

required_elements.text: In non-arctic service, the 4L80-E requires Dexron III; Dexron II is not acceptable.
Dexron II is permitted in the transfer case. PMCS names II; the Change 2 lubrication table permits II or III. Do not require II-only exclusivity.
On level ground, transfer-case fluid must be within 1/2 inch (12.7 mm) of the fill opening.

question: After fording, what general instruction applies to items found contaminated, and what GO refill quantities are listed for each axle differential and each geared hub?
finding: differential과 geared hub 용량을 구분하고 도하 후 오염 시 조치를 확인했다.

required_elements.text: Relubricate all items found contaminated after fording.
Each axle differential: 2 quarts of GO.
Each geared hub: 1 pint of GO.

question: What does the vent system do during normal operation and deep-water fording, and what physical conditions of vent tubes are checked during deep-water-fording-kit PMCS?
finding: 환기 기능 및 점검 조건을 확인했다. S04와 같은 비필수 위치 설명의 연결 오류를 별도 기록했다.

required_elements.text: Normal operation: let vapor escape.
Fording: prevent venting so water does not enter systems.
Inspect vent tubes for bends, cracks, breaks, deterioration and restrictions.

question: At an annual inspection, are semiannual checks also required? For the air-intake CDR valve, what cleaning method must be used and what method is prohibited?
finding: Annual에 Semiannual이 포함된다는 주기 정의를 함께 사용했다.

required_elements.text: All semiannual inspections are included with annual inspections.
Wipe the CDR valve with a rag.
Do not clean the CDR valve with solvent. The diaphragm-damage explanation is optional for this question.

question: For prolonged operation below -15°F (-26°C), what general lubricant-change instruction applies, and what fluid do the transmission PMCS notes specify for both transmission models in arctic conditions?
finding: 극한 기온 및 3L80/4L80 적용을 확인했다.

required_elements.text: Remove lubricants prescribed for above -15°F and relubricate with those specified for below -15°F.
In arctic conditions, use OEA in both 3L80 and 4L80-E transmissions.

question: A fuel-filter element has covered 6,500 miles in ten months. Is its replacement due under PMCS, and which additional inspection set must accompany the annual inspections?
finding: 거리·시간 중 먼저 도달한 주기를 적용했다.

required_elements.text: Fuel-filter replacement interval: 6,000 miles or annually, whichever occurs first.
Replacement is due at 6,500 miles despite only ten months elapsed.
Annual inspections include all semiannual inspections.

question: What time-or-mileage interval triggers biennial PMCS, and when must the Final Road Test occur during that service?
finding: 24개월/12,000 mile 중 먼저 도달한 주기와 마지막 road test를 확인했다.

required_elements.text: Every 24 months or 12,000 miles (19,308 km), whichever comes first.
Final Road Test follows completion of the last annual/biennial task.

question: A battery cell has specific gravity 1.200, while STE/ICE-R Test 73 reports 20 milliohms. How does each compare with its respective PMCS or diagnostic criterion?
finding: 비중과 저항은 서로 다른 판단 기준이며 문항의 실제 값은 경계값이 아니다.

required_elements.text: Specific gravity below 1.225 is the PMCS deficiency criterion.
1.200 fails that criterion.
Test 73 resistance threshold is 25 milliohms.
20 milliohms meets that criterion.

question: What cleaning agent is generally specified for grease or oil on metal parts, and why must that general choice not be applied to the CDR valve? Give the authorized CDR method.
finding: 금속 부품과 CDR diaphragm을 구분했다. 이 문항은 이유까지 물으므로 손상 이유가 필수다.

required_elements.text: General metal-parts instruction uses drycleaning solvent.
Solvent damages the CDR diaphragm.
CDR cleaning is by wiping with a rag.

question: For steering-system inspection, what tightening torque is specified for steering-gear mounting bolts, and what maximum output pressure is listed for the power-steering pump?
finding: 같은 steering gear mounting capscrew의 60 ft-lb를 명시한 C005773을 동등 근거로 추가했다.

required_elements.text: Steering-gear mounting bolts: 60 lb-ft (81 N·m).
Power-steering pump maximum output pressure: 1,450 psi (9,998 kPa).

question: As coolant warms, which stated temperature is reached first: the thermostat fully-open temperature or fan-activation temperature? Give both values.
finding: thermostat의 완전 열림과 팬 작동 온도를 구분했다.

required_elements.text: Thermostat fully open: 212°F (100°C).
Fan activation: 215°F (102°C).
The fully-open thermostat temperature is lower and is reached first under the question premise.

question: If AOAP is unavailable, what engine oil-and-filter change intervals are stated, and what capacity is listed for the engine crankcase including the filter?
finding: AOAP 사용 불가, hourmeter 유무, 주기 중 먼저 도달 및 필터 포함 조건을 유지했다.

required_elements.text: Without AOAP, change engine oil and filter at 3,000 miles (4,800 km).
The alternative interval is 100 operating hours if an hour meter is installed.
The time interval is six months; the listed intervals are alternatives.
Crankcase including filter capacity is 8 quarts (7.6 L).

question: Does the general PMCS drivebelt-tension range apply to M1123 vehicles, and which paragraph is cited for replacement of their worn serpentine belt?
finding: M1123/A2 제외 조건과 serpentine belt 별도 참조를 확인했다.

required_elements.text: No: the PMCS tension-range entry excludes M1123 and A2 vehicles.
Replacement of the M1123/A2 serpentine belt is referred to §3-83.

question: On an M997, the DC outlet reads 26 V with the engine running; a separate alternator test reads 28 V at 1,200-1,500 RPM. Does each meet its specified voltage range?
finding: DC outlet과 alternator의 시험 조건 및 전압 범위를 구분했다.

required_elements.text: Running-engine M997 DC outlet range: 27-28 V.
26 V is below that range.
Alternator output at 1,200-1,500 RPM: 27-29 V.
28 V is within that range.

question: Is failure to develop full engine power a stated reason to check the air-intake/exhaust system, and how does a dust-unloader center opening of 0.20 inch compare with its PMCS limit?
finding: 출력 부족의 intake/exhaust 근거와 unloader 수치를 확인했다. gold-v2의 C002086 동등 근거는 타당하다.

required_elements.text: Failure to develop full power is a stated reason to check intake/exhaust.
Dust-unloader deficiency threshold: center opening exceeding 1/8 inch (0.125 inch; 3.175 mm).
0.20 inch exceeds the threshold.

question: What conversion does the hydro-boost unit perform in the steering-system description, and which four steering-system components are identified as possible influences on hydro-booster operation in the brake guidance?
finding: hydroboost 변환과 조향 계통 구성요소를 구분했다.

required_elements.text: Hydro-boost converts hydraulic power from the steering pump into mechanical power at the master cylinder for braking assistance.
A defective power-steering pump can affect hydro-booster operation.
A defective steering gear can affect hydro-booster operation.
Defective hoses can affect hydro-booster operation.
A defective control valve can affect hydro-booster operation.

question: What is the complete step-by-step procedure for removing and installing the starter motor, including the mounting-bolt tightening torque?
finding: 요청한 전체 절차는 §4-8의 제2권 범위다. 제1권의 관련 경고·점검 정보만으로 전체 절차를 구성하지 않는다. 권 구성(20~23쪽)과 본문의 참조를 대조했다.

question: How should a failed protective control box be removed and a replacement installed, from disconnection through final reassembly?
finding: 요청한 전체 절차는 §4-5의 제2권 범위다. 제1권의 관련 경고·점검 정보만으로 전체 절차를 구성하지 않는다. 권 구성(20~23쪽)과 본문의 참조를 대조했다.

question: Provide the removal and installation sequence for replacing the distribution box, including its mounting and harness reconnection steps.
